Full packaged regression run: PASS

Durable time/provenance precision:
  PASS test_durable_epoch_precision.rex
  Exact 13-digit epoch milliseconds survive starter receipt, migration journal
  and provenance append/reload/digest validation without DIGITS 9 rounding.

Managed initial placement:
  PASS test_managed_placement.rex
  PASS test_managed_placement_failure.rex
  Job-to-Node remains placement/admission/ownership authority. Failed or
  uncertain starts retain placement until an explicit managed release.

Storage Fabric:
  PASS test_storage_load.rex
  PASS test_storage_resume.rex
  Resumable checkpoint transfer pauses and resumes at durable byte offset and is
  verified before migration execution commit.

Queue Fabric / status:
  PASS test_queue_load.rex
  PASS test_queue_dispatch.rex
  PASS test_queue_remote_handoff.rex
  PASS test_status_topic.rex
  Queue/file handoff remains transport-neutral. Live status remains retained
  publish/subscribe observation; migration commands/acks remain direct traffic.

Remote initial placed start (v0.2.5):
  PASS test_remote_placed_start.rex
    Queue Fabric request/reply NEW start; destination rechecks the exact lease;
    durable RPC/service restart replay does not start the workload twice; changed
    lease binding under the same startId fails REQUEST_ID_CONFLICT. Transport
    sentEpochMs is audit metadata, not semantic replay identity.
  PASS test_remote_start_pending.rex
    Dispatch/reply uncertainty returns START_PENDING_PLACEMENT_HELD and never
    auto-releases a placement whose execution outcome may be unknown.
  PASS test_remote_start_network_verifier.rex
    Destination lease verification uses authoritative
    job.node.allocator.network/0.1 CHECK with a fresh per-check request id. A
    released/stale lease is rejected.

Crypto:
  PASS test_foreign_runtime_digest.rex
  JobNode/Migratable Job SHA-256 uses Crypto v0.8.3 with the Foreign Runtime /
  OpenSSL provider during qualification.

Known upstream precision issue (not forked in Migratable Job):
  Exact Job-to-Node Allocator v0.6 currently assigns JobNodePlacementLease
  issuedEpochMs/expiresEpochMs using default-precision `+0`. At contemporary Unix
  epoch-millisecond magnitudes this can round values under ooRexx DIGITS 9.
  v0.2.5 corrects all Migratable Job-owned epoch values and avoids using rounded
  epoch text as an RPC uniqueness source, but leaves Job-to-Node source unchanged.
  This should be corrected and separately qualified in the Job-to-Node project.

Authority invariants retained:
- Initial NEW execution is post-placement and cannot make the starter a scheduler.
- Destination execution revalidates placement immediately before the runtime side effect.
- Planned migration remains separate from node-loss recovery.
- Source checkpoint precedes ownership fencing; replacement placement follows fencing.
- RUNNING requires destination execution evidence/acknowledgement, not mere queue insertion.
- File/manual and Queue Fabric handoff remain peer transports over the same authority state machine.
